chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Making up the Night Prayer after the Morning Prayer and after the Afternoon Prayer is among the hidden secrets of the Family of Muhammad."

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the Family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the Night Prayer performed during the night
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: making up an act of worship after its proper time

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to make up Salat al-Layl after the morning prayer or after the afternoon prayer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that making up Salat al-Layl after the morning prayer and after the afternoon prayer is a distinctive teaching preserved by the Ahl al-Bayt. The hadith indicates the legitimacy and special status of this devotional practice within their transmitted knowledge.
